PM Modi Discusses AI, Environment, and National Initiatives in Mann Ki Baat

In his Mann Ki Baat address, Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasized the importance of responsible Artificial Intelligence adoption for India's development goals. He also made an appeal for environmental conservation, specifically advocating for rainwater harvesting and the use of clay idols. The address touched upon various national initiatives, including a drug-free India campaign and insurance schemes, alongside highlighting indigenous defense manufacturing.
